changes.title: Replay and game-loading isolation
changes.text: An interrupted game-loading wait can no longer proceed while seed replay still owns and restores shared dungeon state.

changes.title: Replay load-barrier regressions
changes.text: Added real replay-thread tests for normal and interrupted loading waits, including preserved interruption status.

changes.title: Native statistics controls
changes.text: UIMSD navigation now uses SPD's existing grey buttons while preserving every existing action.

changes.title: Compact fictional-data indicator
changes.text: Demo and sample statistics use a compact amber DEMO DATA indicator with an information popup instead of a wide red banner.

changes.title: Fictional-data popup verification
changes.text: Android checks now tap the compact data indicator and capture its popup alongside the rendered Home screen.

changes.title: Verified reliability evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST77 checks, reproduced replay interruption and the corrected visual acceptance evidence.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I tightened replay isolation so loading waits for borrowed state to be restored. I also replaced the statistics screen's remaining red navigation and large demo banner with native grey controls.
